title: Sufficiency of Scripture
definition: The sufficiency of Scripture means that the Bible contains everything God intends His people to have for salvation, faith, obedience, doctrine, correction, and godly living.
summary: Scripture is enough for the purposes God gave it. It does not answer every curiosity, but it fully reveals what is necessary for knowing God, trusting Christ, living faithfully, resisting falsehood, and growing in godliness.
christFocus: Scripture is sufficient because it leads us to Christ and teaches us how to follow Him. The Bible does not merely give religious information; it reveals the Savior and equips His people for every good work.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God has given His people a sufficient Word. No new revelation, religious system, human tradition, or private spiritual claim is needed to complete what God has provided for salvation and faithful obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Believers are often tempted to seek spiritual certainty in experiences, personalities, trends, or hidden knowledge. The sufficiency of Scripture anchors the church in what God has already revealed.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Use Scripture as the primary guide for teaching, counsel, worship, correction, encouragement, and spiritual growth. Let the Word shape your life before seeking answers elsewhere.
